subject: Raftlane onboarding — PO issuance / spend cap and line-item corrections
messages:
From: Raftlane Procurement <procurement@raftlane.io>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 03 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: New vendor onboarding: PO issuance + spend cap mismatch

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the quick intake call this morning. We're ready to move Raftlane onto Redwood's platform — attaching the completed onboarding form and SKU manifest. A couple of items we need help with before we can finalize procurement:

- Can you issue a provisional PO number for our initial quarter? Our internal systems expect one to process the first invoice.
- The spend cap shown on the onboarding form is $25,000, but procurement approval in our system was for $75,000. We think the lower cap came from a stale template.
- Line items: the SKU manifest includes three usage tiers but the line-item breakdown on the form collapsed tiers 2 and 3 into a single line which will cause reconciliation mismatches.

Attachments: raftlane_onboarding_form.pdf (application/pdf), raftlane_sku_manifest.csv (text/csv)

Any chance you can provisionally issue a PO and confirm the spend cap mapping so our AP team can accept invoices? We're hoping to have the first invoice processed week of Feb 9.

Appreciate it,

Lena Brooks
Vendor Operations | Raftlane
procurement@raftlane.io

--
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Raftlane Procurement <procurement@raftlane.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding: PO issuance + spend cap mismatch

Hi Lena — thanks for the materials and the clear notes. Looping in Ben (procurement ops) and Grace (finance) to get the PO issued and the spend cap corrected. Quick plan:

1) Ben will validate the SKU -> line-item mapping and produce a PO map we can attach to the PO.
2) Grace will review and provisionally approve the $75k spend cap (we'll need a short approval note for our finance audit trail).
3) Once finance signs off, we can issue a provisional PO number (format: REDW-RAFT-####) and share the DocuSign for signature.

Ben / Grace — can you confirm ETA (EOD today / tomorrow morning) so I can set expectations with Raftlane's AP team?

Thanks — Dylan
Director, Strategic Onboarding | Redwood Inference
--
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Raftlane Procurement <procurement@raftlane.io>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Feb 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding: PO issuance + spend cap mismatch

Hi all,

Reviewed the manifest and the onboarding PDF. Observations and next steps:

- The onboarding form's line-item #2 combined Tier B (monthly active) and Tier C (overage) into one bucket — I've split those into two lines in the attached PO_MAP v2.
- Suggested PO line-item breakdown:
  * Line 100: Base subscription (Tier A) — code SUBS-100 — estimated monthly $18,000
  * Line 110: Tier B (MAU) — code USG-110 — estimated monthly $40,000 cap allocation
  * Line 120: Tier C (Overage) — code OVR-120 — contingency allocation $17,000
- Total provisional spend cap: $75,000 (quarterly allocation). Please note: line 120 is contingency and should be flagged in the invoice notes when used.

I attached po_map_v2.xlsx with the SKU -> Redwood line mapping and suggested GL/account codes. If Grace approves the $75k cap, we can provisionally assign REDW-RAFT-0007 as the PO number (internal routing only) and issue DocuSign for signature. The final PO number will be set once the DocuSign completes.

Attachments: po_map_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Action items:
- Grace: approve spend cap and GL codes (EOD).
- Raftlane: confirm you accept the line split and contingency handling.

Cheers,
Ben
Procurement Ops | Redwood Inference

Confirmed — finance approves the provisional $75,000 quarterly cap for Raftlane. Notes for the record:

- Approval rationale: strategic onboarding quarter + anticipated MAU mix.
- Requirement: contingency line (OVR-120) must be explicitly flagged on any invoice that consumes contingency funds; AP should contact us before clearing such invoices.

Ben — you can proceed to mark REDW-RAFT-0007 as the provisional PO in our system and generate the DocuSign packet. Dylan — please confirm with Raftlane that contingency handling is acceptable and ask them to sign the DocuSign by Feb 9 to avoid invoice timing delays.
